name: RecordCrateBrowser
job: Browse items like flicking through a record crate: sleeves tip forward one by one so the front one is readable
visitor_action: scroll wheel/swipe over the crate or press arrows to flick; click the front sleeve to open
motion: sleeves rock forward with eased overshoot and settle (reduced-motion: front sleeve swaps without tilt)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Record shop: raw birch crate, slightly worn card sleeves, mustard and teal accents, small price stickers
notes: Long subtitles wrap onto the front sleeve's price sticker and can grow tall in the worst case; render and craft checks skipped per 2026-11-23 batch instruction 2026-11-23: replaced 404 default images
